text: {"lessons":["Selling stocks simply because they are above my average cost can reduce positions without improving my overall portfolio; I should base trades on my plan, not gain or loss labels.","My account value fluctuated despite little trading, reminding me that short-term price moves are uncertain and do not call for a reaction each month.","Because I monitor infrequently, I should keep a clear long-term allocation plan and trade only when it meaningfully needs adjustment."]}
